title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
lineage: CDR > EAC > WavMerge > CD-Wave > Soundforge > TLH > FLAC.

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1982 fall show captured on a remarkably clear audience recording, featuring a smoking Bertha opener, the debut of Touch of Grey and a thunderous Phil chant into a monster Other One.
ai_review.review: The concert is remembered as one of the most vibrant shows of the ’82 fall tour – the crowd was electric from the opening Bertha through the second‑set fireworks of Spanish Jam, the Phil chant and a blistering Other One.  The audience (field) recording is praised for its three‑dimensional clarity, making it feel like you’re back in the venue, though a few reviewers note Jerry’s vocals are a bit less nuanced than usual.  Overall the performance and the tape combine to create an especially enjoyable listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 5) and enthusiastic comments about both performance and audio quality; minor vocal critique does not outweigh the strong positive consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Field recording praised for crisp, immersive 3‑D soundstage; described as one of the best audience tapes, with clear instrument separation. Minor note: Jerry’s vocal subtlety is a bit muted.

standout_songs: Going Down the Road / Sugar Magnolia
Spanish Jam → Phil Chant → The Other One
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opening with Bertha and Althea, solid first set; second set builds momentum with new material and culminates in a high‑energy jam leading into the iconic Phil chant and a monster Other One.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals lack some of their usual subtlety on this date, but he still gives it his all; guitar work remains solid.
band_member_comments.Phil: Fans erupted in a Phil chant and he delivered "major bombs" on bass during the jam.
